summary: Expandable mobile nav — the crowded bottom bar (8 live modules squeezed into 44px targets, labels at 8px) is restructured: the bar keeps only the first-2 + last-2 live modules with a raised center Menu FAB that opens a bottom sheet listing EVERY live module as a 52px row. The un-wired chat placeholder button/sheet is retired. Adding a ninth module can no longer crowd the bar.
details: app/src/components/bottom-nav.tsx: bar keeps liveModules.slice(0,2) left / slice(Math.max(2, len-2)) right (no overlap at any length; len<=2 → right empty); center Menu FAB (rounded-full, raised -mt-10) replaces the MessageCircle chat button; labels back to 10px

app/src/components/nav-sheet.tsx (new): bottom sheet listing every live module — fixed overlay z-[60] (above the bar z-50) + panel, backdrop click + ESC close, active page boxed/highlighted, max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto, safe-area padding, md:hidden so it can't survive a breakpoint crossing

presence-map.tsx: MapContainer gains `isolate` — Leaflet panes (tile 200 → popup 700) previously sat in the ROOT stacking context and covered the sheet (z-[60]) on the map page; the whole map is now one stacking context so it can never fight an overlay
i18n: nav.menu / nav.menuDek / nav.close added in en + zh-Hant (parity kept); nav.chat left in place (the kept-unused chat-sheet.tsx still references the chat.* namespace)
chat-sheet.tsx kept on disk (unused, imported by nothing live) — retired via the bar no longer referencing it; nav-icons.test.ts mocks NavSheet alongside it
limitations: Sheet has no focus trap / focus return — byte-identical to the retired ChatSheet (documented MINOR, unchanged for consistency; a focus-management pass is a follow-up)
Desktop sidebar navigation unchanged — this is mobile-only (md:hidden bar)
